name: Bon bon Cai Nuoc
summary: Bồn bồn Cái Nước is the pickled rush of that town. VOV calls it dưa bồn bồn Cái Nước, a collective trademark. Vietnam Airlines lists dưa bồn bồn on the gift list. Nhân Dân lists bồn bồn Cái Nước among the same marks.
origin: Cái Nước. VOV says each collective product on that list belongs to one district and that the district farmers’ association holds the mark.
howToEat: Carry the pickle. VOV, Vietnam Airlines, and Nhân Dân do not print a serving or a price. Check on arrival.
where: Cái Nước. No stall is named. Check on arrival.
